Record Class AnalyticsController.ArtistItem

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.controller.AnalyticsController.ArtistItem
Record Components:
artistId - the artist id, or null for a placeholder row
artistName - the artist name ("—" for placeholders, empty for unplayed artists)
listeningTime - the formatted listening time such as "2h 15m"
Enclosing class:
AnalyticsController
public static record AnalyticsController.ArtistItem(Long artistId, String artistName, String listeningTime) extends Record
A top-artists row.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
